Power-Systems Engineer said about it: Department of Energy Collegiate Wind Competition (E30) which states a three-phase permanent magnet brushless motor was chosen for a generator then converted to DC via a three-phase bridge rectifier, and I adopt that layout; I read the Business Plan and Technical Report (E29) which states a full-bridge Schottky three-phase rectifier was selected with only about 0.6 V drop plus a smoothing capacitor, and I use that low-loss bridge.
Power-Systems Engineer said about it: The swing from (E37) 6.50 V to (E36) 14.3 V is sized by the outrunner-generator-voltage-matching skill (E35) step calling for buck-boost for about 2-to-1 swing, with the Business Plan and Technical Report (E29) bridge drop under 1 V.

statements.text: Department of Energy Collegiate Wind Competition (E30) which states a three-phase permanent magnet brushless motor was chosen for a generator then converted to DC via a three-phase bridge rectifier, and I adopt that layout; I read the Business Plan and Technical Report (E29) which states a full-bridge Schottky three-phase rectifier was selected with only about 0.6 V drop plus a smoothing capacitor, and I use that low-loss bridge.

The swing from (E37) 6.50 V to (E36) 14.3 V is sized by the outrunner-generator-voltage-matching skill (E35) step calling for buck-boost for about 2-to-1 swing, with the Business Plan and Technical Report (E29) bridge drop under 1 V.
